fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models

Class AbstractCoupledModelFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.AbstractCoupledModelFactory
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    CoupledModelFactoryI, java.io.Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    BasicCoupledModelFactory, StandardCoupledModelFactory

    public abstract class AbstractCoupledModelFactory
extends java.lang.Object
implements CoupledModelFactoryI, java.io.Serializable
    The abstract class AbstractCoupledModelFactory provides the basic implementation for coupled model factories.

    Description

    Implementation Invariants

      • setCoupledModelCreationParameters

        public void setCoupledModelCreationParameters(ModelI[] models,
                                              java.lang.String modelURI,
                                              java.util.Map<java.lang.Class<? extends EventI>,EventSink[]> imported,
                                              java.util.Map<java.lang.Class<? extends EventI>,ReexportedEvent> reexported,

                                              java.util.Map<VariableSource,VariableSink[]> bindings)
        Description copied from interface: CoupledModelFactoryI
        set the parameters needed to create a coupled model.

        Contract

         pre     models != null and models.length > 0
 pre     Stream.of(models).allMatch(m -> m != null)
 pre     modelURI != null && !modelURI.isEmpty()
 pre     { tu = models[0].getSimulatedTimeUnit(); return Stream.of(models).allMatch(m -> m.getSimulatedTimeUnit().equals(tu));}
 post    modelParametersSet()
        Specified by:
        setCoupledModelCreationParameters in interface CoupledModelFactoryI
        Parameters:
        models - models to be composed.
        modelURI - URI of the resulting coupled model.
        imported - imported events and their conversion to submodels imported ones.
        reexported - exported events from submodels and their conversion to exported ones.
        connections - connections between exported and imported events among submodels.
        importedVars - variables imported by the coupled model.
        reexportedVars - variables exported by the coupled model.
        bindings - bindings of variables exported and imported by submodels.
